summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper; nothing committed. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with eleven members and per-member comments. botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins, makes the STS predicate accept endpoint_config=None, and adds compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults plus a private _compute_sdk_endpoint helper. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 26 tests. Results: test_args.py, test_regions.py, and test_client.py pass (414 tests). The full tests/unit run has 11 failures that are identical on the untouched tree, so they predate this change. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is None when absent so the mapping always has eleven keys; the helper calls the bridge's private variant and DualStack lookups. Lint: added lines fit in 79 columns, but isort and black were not run because flake8 is not in the shared venv; botocore/args.py:315 is 82 columns and predates this change.
